links.outcome: Accuracy drop from held-out test set to field deployment for view classification
links.effect: Overall accuracy 0.9881 on test set versus 0.9607 after field deployment; recall 0.9867 vs 0.9499; F1 0.9867 vs 0.9530.
links.quote: After field deployment, the model's overall accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score for view classification were 0.9607, 0.9586, 0.9499, and 0.9530, respectively.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an echocardiography view classification model, including reporting performance after field deployment and latency on edge devices, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
